title: Code and per-dataset results for: Leakage-Free Evaluation of Layer Choice in Protein Language Models for Mutation Effect Prediction (BIOINF-2026-2348, third revision)
description: Code, per-dataset results, manuscript and Supplementary Information for the third revision of manuscript BIOINF-2026-2348 (Bioinformatics). This version matches the third-revision manuscript and Supplementary Information, which are included. It adds: (1) the primary mutant-arm analysis on single-substitution variants under the position-based (modulo, contiguous, position-grouped) splits, because rows of a multi-site variant share one averaged embedding and one label across folds; (2) the corrected multi-site share (49,131 of 213,393 analyzed rows, 23.0%, in 10 of 63 datasets) and per-dataset counts of test rows that share a variant with training; (3) the equivalence analysis recomputed under this primary analysis (21 comparisons: 7 equivalent, 14 inconclusive, 0 beyond the 0.01 margin; largest point estimate 0.019, largest 90% upper bound 0.036) with t-based and TOST verdicts; (4) sensitivity analyses (single-substitution probing of all arms, exclusion of datasets with fewer than 50 single substitutions, pooling without multi-site datasets, probing on the 46 assays shared with ProteinGym v1.3); (5) redrawn figures with 200-position similarity matrices; and (6) build and audit scripts for the manuscript and Supplementary Information. Hard-coded remote-server credentials in four early scripts were replaced by environment variables.
